title: Something to Carry It In
description:
A farm produces more than a player can hold. The **Backpack** is the answer, and it's the single most useful thing in this pack.

Wear it in the back slot, or hold it and right-click to open. It keeps its contents when dropped.

Normally backpacks need leather. Here, **canvas works too** — four straw makes a canvas, and straw comes from cutting grass. No cows need to die for your luggage.

*Press R on a backpack in JEI to see both recipes.*
